title: Exponent Beta Exponential Distribution: Its Properties and Applications
content: Statistical theory frequently involves adding a parameter to standard distributions. This work introduces a novel distribution called the Exponent Beta Exponential distribution. Several aspects of the proposed distribution are determined, the moment generating function (mgf), mode, quantiles and order statistics etc. The parameters were estimated the maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) technique. The proposed distribution was evaluated on two datasets. The proposed distribution outperforms over the various ver-sions of Exponential distributions based on model selection criteria’s.
